title: Course Platform
wikitext:
== Overview ==
'''Course Platform''' is LearnTech Solutions' flagship product - a comprehensive learning management system (LMS).

== Features ==
=== For Students ===
* Interactive video player
* Quiz and assessment builder
* Progress tracking
* Certificates of completion

=== For Instructors ===
* Rich text editor
* Video upload and hosting
* Quiz builder
* Course analytics

== Pricing ==
| Free Preview | $0 |
| Single Course | $49-$199 |
| Pro Membership | $29/month |

* [[Learning Analytics]]
* [[Adaptive Learning]]
